chapter: East of the Moon, West of the Sun

quests.title: Whisper Beneath the Waves

dialogue.t: {NICKNAME}, do you feel okay? Paimon's getting a little dizzy over here...
Huh... Paimon thinks she just heard someone talking...
Wow... There's a bunch of those shiny little things we saw earlier! Wait, where are we, anyway?
Could it be we've circled round to right under that weird tree? And those green things... what even are they?

dialogue.sit: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogue.t: Fishing. Though so far, I've only caught things that aren't fish.

If it were knick-knacks from shipwrecks, that'd be fine, 'cause traveling merchants would buy those. I once pulled up a boot with half a... *sigh* Forget it. Talking about stuff like that will scare the fish off.
Did you see that? The tree just lit up all of a sudden, and these little things... Too bad they're not fish.
So that thing in the center must be its root, huh? Paimon doesn't understand how it works, but now that it's all shiny, it looks way better than when it was dull.
It's pretty hard to believe... But you've got no reason to spin me a yarn. Looks like that fishing buddy of mine, that half-Frostmoon Scion, was right after all.
But so what? They're just remnants of the past. Whatever they sing or say, it's not gonna stop us living folks from catching living fish.
Anyway, you folks are treasure hunters, aren't you? That thing you picked up earlier...
This is the <color=#00E1FFFF>Proof of the Cognoscenti</color>? It looks like an ordinary feather...

A trader I know once said that if you collect five <color=#00E1FFFF>Proofs of the Cognoscenti</color>, you'll uncover that "Great Treasure" east of the moon and west of the sun. Who knows if it's true?
Still, a lot of treasure hunters seem to believe the stories. They're all rushing after it like crazy.
Well, it's treasure, after all! If you ask Paimon, she's kinda curious too.
If I were 20 years younger... Nah, even then, I'd still be out here fishing. That said, another day, another empty bucket...
